notes: Human Foods Program letter combining unapproved-new-drug and misbranding charges (disease-treatment claims on the firm's website and product labels for Cardiag, Diabetech, Cleanse-CAMP, MACA, Kidney Cleanse, and Pure Pysyllium Husk) with on-site 21 CFR Part 111 dietary-supplement CGMP findings (missing product specifications, no master manufacturing records, no batch production records, no returned-product procedures) that adulterate Cardiag, Cleanse-camp, and MACA 1000 mg. Classified as food_supplement since the Part 111 CGMP/adulteration section covers a substantial share of the charges, though unapproved_new_drug and misbranding are also cited. No FEI is stated in the letter.
